name: Goodberry

header.Components: V, S, M (a sprig of mistletoe)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Create ten actual berries for 24 hours; Bonus Action eats one for 1 HP and daily nourishment; quantities, expiry and consumption belong to exact created batch.

rules.text: Ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration.
A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry.
Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.
Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.
